description: FCC ULS active licences with at least one frequency in the band and a lat/lon-resolvable location in WA within 40 km of downtown Seattle (47.6062,-122.3321). Licences with county-only locations (no coordinates) are omitted. Station classes: FB/FB2/FB6/FBT = base/repeater transmit, FX* = fixed, MO* = mobile, FXO = fixed receive/other. Repeater pairs: base TX is the higher (e.g. 461-470) or the 451-453 (mobile-relay base) channel; the paired mobile TX is 5 MHz away (UHF) / 45 MHz (800 MHz).
likely_modes_note: likely_modes is a heuristic from FCC emission designators (7K60FX*=DMR TDMA, 4K00F*=NXDN 6.25k, 8K30F*=NXDN 12.5k, 8K10F1*=P25 Ph1, 11K2F3E=analog FM). A licence is not proof of operation.
